symptom_short: Cluster non-DFS-used space is doubled after a dead datanode re-registers

milestones.note: Folder scaffolded; created PROGRESS.md and state.json.

Fix committed to trunk (c4a85c6) AND cherry-picked to branch-2.x. The doubling ONLY manifests on branch-2.7: there register()->addDatanode() does stats.add(d) with the STALE nonDfsUsed BEFORE updateHeartbeatState(EMPTY) clears it. Trunk/2.8/2.9 already reset before add, masking the bug (verified: trunk pre-fix reproduction shows correct 10000, no doubling). So the faithful pre-fix tree is branch-2.7: fix=f90b9d2 (also patches HeartbeatManager.register ordering), pre_fix=b516235. private/fix.diff is the 2.7 fix; fix.trunk.diff kept for reference.
Built hadoop-hdfs 2.7.4-SNAPSHOT -am from branch-2.7 pre-fix with JDK8+protobuf2.5.0 image. No pom edits needed (toolchain-only). hadoop-hdfs jar + all failure-path classes compiled.

REDONE (integrity fix): reproduction now runs with DEBUG logging on and exercises real operations (writes+reads of 3 files) before the dead->re-register cycle. NO print/log statements added anywhere; the earlier PROBE/SYMPTOM breadcrumbs (which leaked the mechanism) are removed. Reproduction is detected by a silent JUnit assertion on the NameNode metric (expected 2097152 vs observed 3145728 = doubled); the assertion output is NOT written to the symptom log. private/symptom.orig.log = the raw verbose log. Added reproduce.md (human-readable reproduction write-up for operator review).

REDONE: logs/symptom.log is now the real 4578-line NameNode/DataNode DEBUG log (3588 DEBUG + 888 INFO lines, real block/heartbeat/replication activity), with ZERO injected markers. Only redactions remain: JIRA id scrub + nonDfsUsed->otherUsed. source/ unchanged (9 real files). Regenerated by reproduce.sh -> anonymize.sh. Verified zero bug-id/nonDfs leakage.

REDONE per updated M5 spec: symptom.md is now ONLY the bare observable (getOtherUsedSpace reads ~3MB vs ~2MB) + a pointer to logs/symptom.log. Removed the trigger/event-sequence and the 'capacity/DFS stay correct' narrowing (both were cause-leaks). Verified: no bug id, no nonDfs, no trigger/mechanism/narrowing in symptom.md. ground_truth.md unchanged.
